description: Patch-attachment noise model fitted from data/data_version1 (+v2) at 250 Hz. All *_frac values are fractions of the per-file MEDIAN ensemble pulse amplitude (peak-to-peak counts) over pulse-carrying channels (files without a detectable pulse use the pooled standard-set median); skew in microseconds.

units.amp_ref: median pulse amplitude (p2p counts) over pulse-carrying channels, per file

dc.note: re-zero: all cells read 0 for a few samples then restart at a new baseline (~360 counts; firmware/AFE offset re-calibration at stage/posture changes). glitch: 1-3 sample all-zero read-out dropout, baseline unchanged.

white.note: flat 15-50 Hz floor; PSD rolls off above hf_corner (AFE decimation filter)

lines.note: ratio of residual PSD at 60 Hz to the 50-70 Hz median; ~1 = no mains line

skew.note: cross-spectral phase slope 2-30 Hz at 250 Hz between pulse-carrying pads; the scatter (ms) is >> the spec TDM skew (0.09-1 ms), so the hardware skew is NOT resolvable from the logs — the model uses the spec value.

epd.note: EPD[x] columns: 8-bit per-channel value; v1 EPD[PB_2..6] duplicates EPD[PA_2..6] exactly (firmware copy) and is nearly constant; v2 varies (std~50) but is weakly correlated with the cell value — meaning not documented, unused by the model.

generative.note: Parameters consumed by js/noiseModelMeasured.js. Amplitudes are fractions of the median pulse amplitude; the twin multiplies by pulseRef_pF / max_over_median so that its best-coupled channel matches the measured best channel.
generative.note_fit: generator = white(sigma, 2-pole LP at corner) + sum of AR(1)[corner Hz, stationary sigma]; least squares in log-PSD over 0.5-110 Hz on the pooled (standard set) residual PSD normalised by A. Below 0.5 Hz use drift.lf_rms_frac / respiration (raw-signal statistics).

twin_realisation.note: what js/noiseModelMeasured.js embeds (rounded): white [sigma_frac, 2-pole LP corner Hz] + AR(1) bank [[corner Hz, sigma_frac], ...]
